printed_precision.meaning: Bounds on decimal printing alone; not SCF, integration, basis, Hamiltonian or physical uncertainty.

double_difference.definition: (Dy mixed - La mixed) - (Dy aquo8 - La aquo8)
double_difference.decision_authority: Published producer scalar retained; Decimal reconstruction records printed-energy bookkeeping and binary-rounding differences, not replacement of the admitted comparison.
double_difference.limits: Fixed-geometry own-basis finite-cluster contrast; not binding free energy, CP-corrected interaction, or physical-state qualification.

symbols.R_el: Sum of native isolated M3+ and entire ligand-shell electronic energies at unchanged geometry, same own-fragment basis/method/charge/effective singlets. Obtained inside the authorized molecular-guess ALMO call.
symbols.F: Native antisymmetrized frozen molecular-guess electronic energy.
symbols.D: Archived full-parent D4 scalar for this exact system.
symbols.D_ref: D4(M3+) + D4(isolated complete ligand shell) for a true isolated-fragment D4 reference; not supplied by the quartet.

full_and_ct_suppressed_absolute_energies.consequence: The same archived D is added once to all three constrained electronic states. POL and CT are unchanged.

explicit_reference_conventions.electronic_fragment_reference_composite: (U+D)-R_el = FRZ+POL+CT+D. This closes numerically but is explicitly a composite relative to electronic-only fragments; do not label it a fully D4-corrected isolated-fragment interaction.
explicit_reference_conventions.true_d4_fragment_reference: (U+D)-(R_el+D_ref) = FRZ+POL+CT+(D-D_ref). Absolute per-system value is unavailable until D_ref is known; no additional fragment calculations authorized here.

conditions: Paired La/Dy nonmetal coordinate lines identical for each motif, with identical shell basis, charge and effective singlet.
Each metal ion reference uses the same isolated charged state and own-ion basis in both motifs.
Native molecular-guess fragment energies must be retained per system; numerical differences for allegedly repeated references remain reported closure residuals rather than silently forced to zero.
double_difference_cancellation.proof: DD[R_el] = (R_Dy-R_La) - (R_Dy-R_La) + (R_shell_mixed-R_shell_mixed) - (R_shell_aquo-R_shell_aquo) = 0; identical algebra gives DD[D_ref]=0. Therefore DD[interaction_el]=DD[U], DD[interaction_total]=DD[U]+DD[D], and DD[CT]=DD[U-P] without any extra external fragment calculations.

paired_geometry_authority.comment_lines: Preserved verbatim; source IDs can differ.
Preserved verbatim; source IDs can differ.

double_difference_cancellation.no_CP_substitution: Cancellation assumes native own-fragment references. A ghost-parent-basis reference could depend on the other metal basis and must not be inserted into this algebra without a separate demonstrated join.

available_now: Four full-parent electronic, full PBE0-D4 and D4 constants.
Exact same-geometry shell/metal identities and charges.
Published total quartet contrast and original AMOEBA comparison.
unavailable_now: Native ALMO R_el/F/P/U and their actual convergence/closure; no CP2K molecular calculation has yet supplied them.
Isolated complete-shell D4 constants and hence true absolute D4-corrected per-system interactions in this quartet archive.
A quantified numerical uncertainty for the exact archived quartet observable; printed thresholds/precision are not that uncertainty.
S6/S8/a1/a2 coefficients are not explicit in the examined ORCA D4 summary; implementation/version/functional/DFTDOPT and actual corrections are available.

prospective_pilot_recommendation.status: Advice only; root must bind before execution. No runtime release or numerical result created.
prospective_pilot_recommendation.pilot: aquo8_central_La only; remaining three only after pilot admission, per user quartet contract.
prospective_pilot_recommendation.comparison: Compare U_CP2K with archived final post-COSX electronic energy; equivalently compare U_CP2K + the same archived D4 constant against archived full energy with the explicit D4 printing residual retained. Never compare U_CP2K directly with PBE0-D4.
prospective_pilot_recommendation.gate_justification: Chosen cross-code implementation qualification scale, not an estimated error bar. It is about twice the largest archived final COSX reintegration shift (0.000049237 Eh), far above decimal rounding, and far below the 6.8109 kcal/mol model discrepancy. Failure would block interpretation; no automatic retuning or protocol substitution.
prospective_pilot_recommendation.quartet_limit: Four independent per-cell bounds of 1e-4 Eh imply only a worst-case 4e-4 Eh (0.2510037896 kcal/mol) DD bound; pilot agreement alone does not establish quartet agreement. Report actual DD discrepancy and native convergence/decomposition residuals, particularly before interpreting a small CT-induced sign change.
prospective_pilot_recommendation.decomposition_closure: Retain all four native energies and compute the literal telescoping residual; its parsing/roundoff bound must be computed from actual printed digits. SCF errors and variational-order residuals are separate.

finite_resource_cap.scheduler_memory_and_time: Use existing scheduler defaults; enforce finite process timeout separately and terminate the actual process group/step on timeout. No automatic retry or cap extension.
finite_resource_cap.rationale: Archived four-rank ORCA energy+gradient runtimes are 374–653 s. A 7200 s cap is an explicit development budget allowing internal fragment/block/full SCFs and unfamiliar CP2K overhead; it is not a performance prediction. Root must bind actual MPI/OpenMP split and inspect current shared-user capacity at launch.

timing_summary.cost_scope: Four original energy+gradient parent invocations, four MPI ranks each. Excludes historical preparation/collection allocations. No inference of peak memory or measured CPU consumption from allocated CPU seconds.
